title: dev-autotask.config.json
description: One repository for the dev-autotask workflow. Looked up from the current directory upward, then ~/.claude/dev-autotask.config.json.

path.description: Absolute path to the main checkout. Never switched or edited; task work happens in a separate worktree.

baseBranch.description: Branch the task starts from and its PR targets.

install.description: Optional dependency install command, run before verify on every verification (e.g. npm ci --ignore-scripts).

verify.description: Non-interactive check commands, run in order with CI=1. The first failure stops the run.

env.description: Extra environment variable names (never values) passed through from the caller to install/verify commands, e.g. DATABASE_URL or NPM_TOKEN.

commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-command deadline; the command's process group is killed when it expires.

forbidden.description: Repository-specific hard rules every phase must follow.

worktreeRoot.description: Where task records and worktrees live; must be outside repo.path.
